description: etcd 3.5 configuration file for the Patroni DCS.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable name of this etcd member; must be unique in the cluster. Filled by the server from the node's role index.
fields.title: Member name

fields.name: data_dir
fields.description: Path to the member's data directory (WAL and snapshots).
fields.title: Data directory

fields.name: listen_peer_urls
fields.description: Comma-separated URLs this member listens on for peer traffic.
fields.title: Listen peer URLs

fields.name: listen_client_urls
fields.description: Comma-separated URLs this member listens on for client traffic.
fields.title: Listen client URLs

fields.name: initial_advertise_peer_urls
fields.description: Peer URLs the other members use to reach this one. Filled by the server from the node's address.
fields.title: Advertise peer URLs

fields.name: advertise_client_urls
fields.description: Client URLs Patroni uses to reach this member. Filled by the server from the node's address.
fields.title: Advertise client URLs

fields.name: initial_cluster
fields.description: Bootstrap membership as `name=peerURL` entries. Filled by the server from the etcd topology.
fields.title: Initial cluster

fields.name: initial_cluster_rendered
fields.description: The initial_cluster list joined with commas — the literal value of the etcd key.
fields.title: Rendered initial cluster

fields.name: initial_cluster_state
fields.description: `new` bootstraps a fresh cluster, `existing` joins one that already exists.
fields.title: Initial cluster state

fields.name: initial_cluster_token
fields.description: Token isolating this cluster from any other etcd cluster on the same network.
fields.title: Initial cluster token

fields.name: heartbeat_interval
fields.description: Interval between leader heartbeats; roughly the round-trip time between members.
fields.title: Heartbeat interval

fields.name: election_timeout
fields.description: Time a follower waits without a heartbeat before starting an election; etcd recommends 10x the heartbeat interval.
fields.title: Election timeout

fields.name: snapshot_count
fields.description: Committed transactions between snapshots to disk.
fields.title: Snapshot count

fields.name: quota_backend_bytes
fields.description: Alarm threshold for the backend size; 0 keeps etcd's default of 2GB.
fields.title: Backend quota

fields.name: auto_compaction_mode
fields.description: `periodic` interprets the retention as a time window, `revision` as a number of revisions.
fields.title: Auto compaction mode

fields.name: auto_compaction_retention
fields.description: Retention for automatic compaction: '0' disables it, '1h' or '1' mean one hour in periodic mode.
fields.title: Auto compaction retention

fields.name: max_request_bytes
fields.description: Largest client request etcd accepts.
fields.title: Max request bytes

fields.name: enable_v2
fields.description: The deprecated etcd v2 API. Off: Patroni 3.x uses etcd3 exclusively.
fields.title: Enable v2 API

fields.name: custom
fields.description: Raw top-level etcd YAML keys appended verbatim; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.title: Extra etcd keys

fields.name: custom_rendered
fields.description: The `custom` map joined into YAML lines appended at the end of the file.
fields.title: Rendered extra keys

rules.message: election-timeout should be at least 5x heartbeat-interval (etcd recommends 10x)
